notes: Database overhead is not applicable: this benchmark is in-process graph analysis.
Model API cost is unknown: no LLM calls are made.
CPU time is not sampled; latency is wall-clock Instant.

limitations: Ground truth includes hidden edges withheld from every strategy. No strategy can detect unregistered dependencies.
Strategies A–D are distinct algorithms (empty set, full declared graph, action resource_id version check, compute_impact).
Approval and external-operation delays are scenario metadata; this microbenchmark does not sleep.
Database overhead is not measured here (no PostgreSQL). Cost per verified outcome is unknown (no model API).
Incorrect-action is defined as missing at least one true-graph action that should have been blocked before a write.
Latency is in-process wall-clock of the strategy function, not end-to-end agent runtime.
